entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • WaitForTextToBePresentInElement does not throw #31217
  • App.ScrollUp does not work to "pull-to-refresh" on macOS #31216
  • [NET9] VersionName und VersionCode not filled when version is build dynamically #31209

Closed

  • [iOS/Catalyst] If the user specifies NULL for the DatePicker then the picker should default to Todays date when it's opened #30641
    .NET 10.0-rc1
  • Repating OpenWindow and CloseWindow casuses crash on Windows #30989
  • iOS CollectionView Handler2 performance is worse than default Handler #28708
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • .NET Maui Codesign error after updating mac os to 15.6 #31192
  • .NET 9 MAUI Blazor App Hangs on Splash Screen on Android 10 Devices with Missing or Outdated WebView Provider #31079
  • Remove internal usage of MessagingCenter #28855
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • [Android] Xamarin.UITest not running with .NET 9 #31208
  • NullReferenceException on iOS in Button.LayoutButton from WrapperView.LayoutSubviews #31048
  • [Android] "MaterialButton manages its own background" log message when setting BackgroundColor to Button #18898

PullRequests

Created

  • [iOS] Update date format in iOS DatePickerExtensions #31220
    platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-datetimepicker
  • [Windows] Fix LineHeight values < 1 having no effect by setting LineStackingStrategy to BlockLineHeight #31219
  • Fix WaitForTextToBePresentInElement to throw TimeoutException instead of returning false #31218
  • [iOS][CV2] Fix CollectionView renders large empty space at bottom of view #31215
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Implement `PointerGestureRecognizer` Buttons #31214
  • [Testing] Added UI test for Issue31139 related to Dispatcher #31213
    area-testing, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [ci] Update rc1 dependencies #31211
    .NET 10.0-rc1
  • [net10.0] Merge main to net10 #31210
    .NET 10.0-rc1
  • [housekeeping] Automated PR to fix formatting errors on net10.0 #31207
    t/housekeeping ♻︎, area-infrastructure

Merged

  • Change ComputeConstraintForView to return LayoutConstraint instead of using side effects #31091
    p/0, .NET 10.0-rc1

    community ✨, area-controls-datetimepicker, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0-rc1

    .NET 10.0-rc1

    area-testing, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, test-flight

    .NET 10.0-rc1

    platform/android, platform/ios, area-controls-label
  • Expose Android Activity and Modal Dialog OnKey* overrides via ConfigureLifecycleEvents with generalized context parameter #31206
    .NET 10.0-rc1
  • Mark Performance and IPerformanceProvider types as obsolete and remove all usages #30942
    .NET 10.0-rc1
  • Add IsRefreshEnabled Property and Platform-Consistent IsEnabled Semantics to RefreshView #30692
    p/0, .NET 10.0-rc1
